determinism_check.method: regenerate selected files with identical argv and compare file SHA-256

generator_invocation: scripts/data/prepare.py builds a multi-line shell command with backslash continuations and runs it with shell=True, which is Linux-only. R4 rebuilt the identical argv in-process and invoked the generator scripts directly without a shell. Every argument, including the composed --template, is byte-identical to prepare.py's construction (model_template_type=base, Templates['base'] == '{task_template}').

reproducibility_boundary.committed_artifact_status: The committed frozen artifacts themselves remain byte-stable and fully verified: 0/32 committed-file hash deviations in a fresh checkout under core.autocrlf=true.
reproducibility_boundary.file_sha256_semantics: file_sha256 identifies the exact frozen byte representation. It is therefore platform-sensitive if the dataset is independently regenerated on another platform.
reproducibility_boundary.generation_platform_semantics: The canonical frozen JSONL files were generated under Windows text-mode semantics and therefore contain CRLF line endings.
reproducibility_boundary.gitattributes: .gitattributes intentionally preserves these exact bytes via `text: unset` (-text) for *.jsonl, SHA256SUMS.txt and 09-SESSIONS/**/generated/**.
reproducibility_boundary.interpretation_rule: A differing regenerated file_sha256 alone must NOT be interpreted as changed substrate when all canonical row hashes and dataset-envelope invariants match.
reproducibility_boundary.linux_regeneration: A Linux regeneration may produce LF-delimited files with a different file_sha256 despite semantically identical rows.
reproducibility_boundary.row_sha256_semantics: row_sha256 is newline-normalization-independent for the validated row content and remains the canonical cross-platform semantic identity check.
reproducibility_boundary.scope: reproducibility-record correction only; no dataset content, generator input, task envelope or verdict is changed
reproducibility_boundary.verdict_impact: No scientific inference, model inference, Gamma verdict or dataset-freeze verdict changes.

verified_observation.counterfactual_note: Measured, not assumed: `git -c core.autocrlf=true hash-object -w --path=counterfactual.txt` on the same file yields the LF blob above, which is why the -text rule is load-bearing for byte identity in the object store.
